cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Say You’re Sorry
cards.instruction: Maneuver someone into apologizing without naming the offense.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Your parents arrive in ten minutes. I'd like to be able to smile at you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought we'd sorted this out by text.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. You sent a thumbs-up. I couldn't hear any remorse.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're right here. Could you give the sad face a sentence beginning with 'I'?
